value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Toddler Gym for 18 months-3.11 yrs, fall session Sept 10-Dec 16 (no class Oct 10) - their site doesn't list the price. They also have a Preschool Drop-In Thursdays 9:30-12 from Oct 9, $15 per parent for up to 4 kids. Want me to call about the toddler class fee?
